notes.title: First Early Access Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’ve been hard at work on a massive update for Apples and Bananas, and I’m so excited to finally share it with you! Here's a quick rundown of what’s new:

-🎮 Revamped Gameplay: New enemy wielding a shotgun and a second weapon—the shotgun—is now in the game!
-🎵 Improved Audio: The soundtrack and most in-game sounds have been completely overhauled for a more immersive experience.
-🗺️ Save and Progress System: Your progress is now saved, and there’s a new map to track your journey through Chapter 1.
-🔦 New Visuals: Lighting upgrades, a cool flashlight feature, and improved effects like glowing bullets and coins.
-🛠️ Quality of Life Updates: Tons of bug fixes and a revamped UI, including a proper settings menu and improved pause menu.
-👑 Reworked Chapter 1 Boss: The boss battle is completely redesigned and better than ever—but I’m not spoiling it. You’ll have to play to see!
This updated version of Apples and Bananas is still in Early Access.

Update now and get playing! 🚀

Stay awesome,
-Sam

notes.title: Some News For Apples And Bananas!
notes.notes:
[h1]Community Announcement: Exciting News for Apples And Bananas![/h1]

Hello everyone,

We have some intriguing updates to share about "Apples And Bananas," our upcoming game from Piggle Studios.

What's Coming?

- New Arsenal: 🍎🍌 Get ready to discover an array of new weapons, including shotguns, assault rifles, and more. Each one brings unique abilities and designs, adding depth to your gameplay experience.

- Boss Revamps: 🍎🍌 Our current boss, The Buff Banana, is getting some company! While he's not Dr. Banana (the main villain), new bosses are on the horizon. These new adversaries will be cooler, unique, and feature multiple stages for epic battles.

- Revamped Original Music: 🎵🍎🍌 We've been working on refreshing our soundtrack. Get ready for a musical experience that enhances the atmosphere and immerses you deeper into the game.

Future Plans:

- More Chapters: 🍎🍌 We're expanding the story with new chapters, each filled with fresh adventures and deeper lore. Prepare for unexpected twists and turns.

- New Fruits: 🍎🍌 🍋🍓🍐🍑We've got some exciting new fruits joining the game. What could they be? Stay tuned to find out!

- Additional Features: 🍎🍌 We're continuously enhancing the gameplay experience with new features. Stay tuned for more updates as we refine and expand the game.

[b]Release Date:[/b]

A release date announcement is coming soon. Keep your eyes peeled for the official date, and prepare to dive into the world of "Apples And Bananas."

We are always reading your feedback and reviews. Your thoughts help us make the game better, so please keep sharing!

Thank you for your support and patience. We can't wait to share more with you soon.

Best regards,
Piggle Studios
